summary: Novo Nordisk filed a Form 6-K reporting a share repurchase program. The program, initiated on 6 May 2026, is part of a broader up-to-DKK 15 billion buyback over 12 months from 4 February 2026. Under the current tranche, the company repurchases B shares for up to DKK 11.2 billion through 1 February 2027. The filing details weekly transactions; as of 29 May 2026, a total of 17,889,179 B shares at an average price of DKK 263.47 have been repurchased, equivalent to 0.8% of total share capital held as treasury. The open-market purchases reduce outstanding shares, are conducted under EU Safe Harbour Rules, and are not subject to a tender offer framework. Watch for the pace of execution as the program runs alongside the company's operational cash flows. No premium or fixed price, and no break fee apply; consideration is cash at market prices.
